issues.reason: "reached the Hollows" is a bare direct object and the direct-object roles are for objects the verb takes without a preposition, while Goal is defined as the "to …" oblique; the instruction set's own worked example "Sara reached the platform" gives reach a Theme.
The per-member rule's conclusion carries the same unlicensed (Goal (sk_reach $x) hollows), so the role error is replicated to every derived member event.

Cardinality's count slot is specified as a native integer, and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only as a Measure-family magnitude or a Time term's value, so (Cardinality (sk_moths $x) (ParticleFromNormal 25 2.5)) is ill-typed per the vocabulary — the calibration line makes an ill-typed atom a defect even in gap territory.

Quantifiers, generics & scope states that the same rule form distributes a distributive predicate over a plural or group ("the dogs barked"), and survive is not one of the reciprocal/aggregate predicates that stay group-only, so the per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_survivors_1) is determined, not optional.

It is correct that the sentence-7 PP yields no atom of its own, but the claim of lost content overstates: the parse takes the licensed NP-attachment reading ("seven of the nightmoths at the East Row"), and the restriction is already carried by (SubsetOf sk_subset_1 sk_crowd_1) over a crowd the parse has already placed with (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 east_row).

gaps_confirmed: a hedged exact count ("about twenty-five nightmoths") has no licensed carrier: Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost take a bound the hedge does not state, and CardinalityPhrase takes a canonical vague-lexicon word
new_gaps: an epoch-relative / day-index calendar ("on day 0 of Year 1"): the Time section's (Day <n>) term is a within-month granularity sitting beside Month/Year, so a day counted off a fictional epoch has no distinct term and will not interoperate with the seeded day/month ordering rules

a temporal-identification of-phrase ("the night of the autumn equinox"): the of-phrase names which night, not a possessor or a nominalization's object, so the loose-association Possession is the only fallback head and it records an association the text states only as identification
defect_summary: The compliant form for "reached the Hollows" is (Theme sk_reach_1 hollows); the per-member rule's conclusion likewise needs (Theme (sk_reach $x) hollows); for "about twenty-five" the instruction set licenses NO form that carries a hedged count, so the compliant parse emits the Skolem group and its GroupOf with no count atom at all and records the gap; and the survive clause needs the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_survivors_1) (And (Member (sk_survive $x) survive) (Agent (sk_survive $x) $x) (Theme (sk_survive $x) sk_hunt_1) (Past (sk_survive $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event.
notes: Naming (Cliff Path / East Row typed-plus-Name, the Hollows Name-only), the s7 partitive, the s1 copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit and the collective/distributive split for gather and shrink are all handled correctly. The Goal-vs-Theme and the missing survive rule are both consistency failures against choices the same parse makes elsewhere.
